0.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_EMILIE_000_000
0.description: The day's crowning event is about to begin, adventurer! Folk from all walks will speak of their greatest love while dressed in the latest Valentione fashions. You'll be staying to watch, of course?

3.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_A1_000_001
3.description: The face of adventure and a fosterer of flora.

4.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_A2_000_001
4.description: The soul of wood and a great oak in the making.

7.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_A5_000_001
7.description: A funny-talking fortune-teller and a furry friend.

8.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_ASTRID_000_010
8.description: Please give a warm welcome to Gridania's very own Mother Miounne and Fufucha! Tell us─what inspired you to participate in today's event?

9.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_MIOUNNE_000_011
9.description: I thought I'd use this opportunity to advertise the Adventurers' Guild, which operates at the Carline Canopy. To those seeking adventure─or a scrumptious eel pie─look no further!

10.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_FUFUCHA_000_012
10.description: And I'm here representing the Botanists' Guild. We hope to cultivate a fondness of flora in one and all!

11.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_EMILIE_000_013
11.description: There's no better way to express one's love than in the company of like-minded friends! Please share with us what it is that you love!

12.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_MIOUNNE_000_014
12.description: Well, I can't speak of love without mentioning tea. Whether I'm enjoying a cup or brewing a pot for a weary soul, tea brings me joy like little else.

13.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_MIOUNNE_100_014
13.description: We serve only the finest teas at the Carline Canopy, and I hope you'll all come and try some. There's a drop for every taste!

14.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_FUFUCHA_000_015
14.description: To that I can attest─though, admittedly, my own adoration lies more with the leaves than the beverage!

15.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_FUFUCHA_100_015
15.description: Be it herbs or fruits or flowers, it's my passion and purpose to understand nature's bounty, for the benefit of both mankind and the star.

16.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_ASTRID_000_016
16.description: Well now, if tea and flowers aren't absolutely perfect for this season of doting! I invite you all to seek out the Carline Canopy and Botanists' Guild to treat yourselves and your loved ones! Thank you, Mother Miounne and Fufucha!

17.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_ASTRID_000_020
17.description: We welcome to the stage two Gridanian mainstays─Timbermaster Beatin and young Nicoliaux! Tell us, what inspired you to participate in today's event?

18.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_BEATINE_000_021
18.description: That should be evident─I desire to share my wood with the world.

19.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_NICOLIAUX_000_022
19.description: I'm here with old Beat─er...I mean, the timbermaster. To keep watch over him, I suppose? Oh, but I'm also hoping to find more younglings to play with us in the Acorn Orchard.

20.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_EMILIE_000_023
20.description: So a hail to new friends and, erm, timber enthusiasts! Lovely! Without further ado, then─what is it that you love?

21.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_BEATINE_000_024
21.description: Your query is simple─but how does one aptly describe the fire kindled within a carpenter's breast at the sight of a quarter-cleft plank?

22.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_BEATINE_100_024
22.description: The thrill of taking hardwood in hand, stroking it end to end, feeling every knot and grain against your fingertips? No words could do such euphoria justice!

23.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_NICOLIAUX_000_025
23.description: Er, what he's saying is...wood is great!

24.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_NICOLIAUX_100_025
24.description: As for me, I love all my friends as well as the carpenters who built our play equipment. That includes the timbermaster, of course!

25.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_ASTRID_000_026
25.description: Marvelous! Those with a love of wood, the Carpenters' Guild has what you desire and more! And young ones who wish to play, don't be shy─run along to the Acorn Orchard and get to know Nicoliaux! Thank you for joining us!

26.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_ASTRID_000_030
26.description: May I have a warm welcome for Lisette de Valentione and her beloved, Ser Hortefense! Tell us─what inspired you to participate in today's event?

27.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_LISETTE_000_031
27.description: Well, I could hardly forgo this splendid production of ardor and affection hosted by my very own emissaries of love!

28.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_HORTEFENSE_000_032
28.description: Precisely! We are here to support you. ...And I suppose I'd like to profess my passions a little as well.

29.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_EMILIE_000_033
29.description: How romantic! You have our audience captivated already─tell us all about your love!

30.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_HORTEFENSE_000_034
30.description: Well, my love...my <hex:021A020203>angel<hex:021A020103> is... Oh, how am I to aptly summarize such feelings!?

31.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_HORTEFENSE_100_034
31.description: Ever since my darling Lisette─my goddess!─first descended upon me as I lay collapsed amongst the pillowed drifts, I knew that I could never love another! Even now, when she gathers me into her milky arms, I─

32.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_LISETTE_000_035
32.description: Wh-What are you doing, saying such embarrassing things out loud!? And what's even worse is...is...

33.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_LISETTE_100_035
33.description: ...I don't dislike it. When you bare your heart to me like that, it makes me think of all <hex:021A020203>I'd<hex:021A020103> like to bare in return...

34.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_ASTRID_000_036
34.description: A-And we seem to be out of time! Perhaps these two love-doves can continue their conversation somewhere private! Thank you very much!

35.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_ASTRID_000_040
35.description: We welcome to the stage former Scions of the Seventh Dawn, Aenor and Clemence! Tell us─what inspired you to participate in today's event?

36.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_AENOR_000_041
36.description: I happen to be staying in Gridania at the moment, so I thought I'd join in the celebration.

37.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_CLEMENCE_000_042
37.description: For my part, I came to the Twelveswood to meet my sister, whom I hadn't seen in a while. But one thing led to another, and now here we are!

38.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_EMILIE_000_043
38.description: What heartwarming familial affection! With that, please share with us what you love most!

39.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_AENOR_000_044
39.description: What I love most...is love. <hex:021A020203>Brotherly<hex:021A020103> love. Aaah, how it used to wash over me in waves of blessed warmth... But that tide has receded and I've been left high and dry.

40.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_AENOR_100_044
40.description: Damn it all! I can't bear it anymore! Can't bear the deprivation! Please don't take it from me! Give me back my brotherly love! <sob>

41.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_CLEMENCE_000_045
41.description: Ugh, give me strength! Can't we make it through a single day without the mention of brotherly love!? And in front of all and sundry, no less! P-Please forget you heard any of that, everyone!

42.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_CLEMENCE_100_045
42.description: ...Ahem! I'm presently studying at the Astrologicum in Ishgard, and I love every moment of it! And once I've concluded my time there, I believe I will next explore Nymian magicks!

43.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_ASTRID_000_046
43.description: Though we've been asked to forget it, I must say I didn't quite understand it myself... Thank you for sharing, Aenor and Clemence, and please enjoy the rest of the festivities!

44.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_ASTRID_000_050
44.description: We have with us today a most honored guest─the one and only Urianger Augurelt, accompanied by the sweet Puddingway! Tell us─what inspired you to participate in today's event?

45.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_URIANGER_000_051
45.description: Simply, these observances of love did seem a worthy endeavor. That I should chance to spy a familiar countenance among those in attendance served as further encouragement.

46.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_PUDDINGWAY_000_052
46.description: And I've come for the pudding!

47.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_EMILIE_000_053
47.description: What a charming duo! Now, please tell us what the crowd is simply dying to know─what do you love?

49.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_PUDDINGWAY_100_054
49.description: Sticky pudding, jiggly pudding, pudding with sweetmeats or biscuits... So long as it is pudding, it brings me unparalleled delight!

50.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_URIANGER_000_055
50.description: Were I to likewise nominate a dish for which I harbor affection, it could be naught else but cockatrice meatballs. Not only for the gastronomic pleasure it doth provide, but the fond memories it doth rouse.

51.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_URIANGER_100_055
51.description: In my youth, knowing it to be my favorite, a dear friend oft prepared it for me. From the burnt flavors of her earliest attempts to the sublime texture of her later handiwork, to simply think of the dish doth transport me back to those halcyon days.

52.name: TEXT_FESVLT2023PRESENTATION_00794_ASTRID_000_056
52.description: Meals shared with a special someone and the undeniable joy of pudding─two exceptional examples of love, indeed! Why, I'm feeling rather peckish myself... Thank you for your participation!
